spans.s:
पौर (रः-री-रं) 1.
m. n. 3.
f. City; citi-
zen.
n. A fragrant grass.

पौरक (कं) 1.
n. A house garden.

पौर-जन (नः) 1.
m. A citizen.

पौरव (वः-वी-वं)
a. Of
Puru race.

पौर-सख्य (ख्यं) 1.
n. Citizenship.

पौरस्त्य (स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं)
a. Prior; eastern.

पौर-स्त्री (स्त्री) 1. 3.
f. A town woman.

पौराण (णः-णी-णं)
a. Of the
Purānas.

पौराणिक (कः) 1.
m. A
brāhman well
read in the
Purānas. a. Purānic.

पौरुष (षः-षा-षं) 1.
m. f. n. The mea-
sure of a man with arms erect.
n. Manhood; action; semen vi-
rile; strength.
a. Manly.

पौरुषता (ता-त्वं) 1.
f. n. Manhood.

पौरुषेय (यः-या-यं)
a. Of man, man-
ly.
m. A crowd; murder; law.

पौरो-गव (वः-वी) 1.
m. 3.
f. Overseer,
superintendent of the kitchen^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

पौरोडाश (शः) 1.
m. A prayer made
on the offering ghee.

पौरोडाशिक (कः) 1.
m. A priest who
makes the above prayer.

पौरोहित्य (त्यं) 1.
n. Duty of a priest.

पौर्णमास (सः) 1.
m. A ceremony per-
formed at the full of the moon.
f. (सी) Day of full moon.

पौर्णिम (मः) 1.
m. An ascetic.
f. (मा)
Day of full moon.

पौर्त्तिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Ceremonial.

पौर्व्व (र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं)
a. Past; eastern.

पौर्व्व-पदिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Of the first
part of a compound.

पौर्व्व-देहिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Of a for-
mer birth.

पौर्व्वा_र्द्धिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Of the eastern half.

पौर्व्वा_पर्य्य (र्य्यं) 1.
n. First and last.

पौर्व्वा_ह्णिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Belonging
to the fore-part of the day.

पौर्व्विक (कः-की-कं)
a. Former.
